node.title: Strict m=1 core-free five-slope Hankel route fence
node.closure: exact finite-field witness and complete locator-line census
node.statement: Over F_17 at the exact strict m=1 analogue, an explicit core-free constant-rank Hankel pencil has five finite split-cubic slopes, exceeding rho+1=4. Among all 560 split cubics, the core-free coefficient-line maximum is exactly five, attained by 16 lines, and every maximizing line has a unique constant-rank Hankel realization. The survivor is rank-two and separated, so this is evidence that the official m>1 component and separation-rank inputs are load-bearing, not an official counterexample.
